    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">国密 SM2 / SM3 / SM4 静态帮助类</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	</div>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Org.BouncyCastle.Utilities.Encoders;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SharpAbp.Abp.Crypto.SM2;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SharpAbp.Abp.Crypto.SM3;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SharpAbp.Abp.Crypto.SM4;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Security.Cryptography;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Text;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Org.BouncyCastle.Crypto.Engines.SM2Engine;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> YourCompany.GmCrypto;

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 国密 SM2 / SM3 / SM4 静态帮助类（基于 SharpAbp.Abp.Crypto）
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SmHelper
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> ISm2EncryptionService Sm2 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm2EncryptionService(
        Options.Create(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AbpSm2EncryptionOptions
        {
            DefaultCurve </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm2EncryptionNames.CurveSm2p256v1
        }));

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> ISm3EncryptionService Sm3 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm3EncryptionService();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> ISm4EncryptionService Sm4 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm4EncryptionService(
        Options.Create(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AbpSm4EncryptionOptions
        {
            DefaultMode </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm4EncryptionNames.ModeCBC,
            DefaultPadding </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm4EncryptionNames.PKCS7Padding,
            DefaultIv </span>= Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1234567890123456</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 16 字节</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }));

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#region</span> SM2

    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">生成 SM2 密钥对（十六进制）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm2KeyPairResult GenerateSm2KeyPair()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> keyPair =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm2.GenerateSm2KeyPair();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm2KeyPairResult
        {
            PublicKeyHex </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> keyPair.ExportPublicKey(),
            PrivateKeyHex </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> keyPair.ExportPrivateKey()
        };
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">SM2 公钥加密，返回十六进制密文</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Sm2Encrypt(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> plainText, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> publicKeyHex)
        </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm2.Encrypt(publicKeyHex, plainText, Encoding.UTF8, mode: Mode.C1C2C3);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">SM2 私钥解密</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Sm2Decrypt(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cipherTextHex, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> privateKeyHex)
        </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm2.Decrypt(privateKeyHex, cipherTextHex, Encoding.UTF8, mode: Mode.C1C2C3);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">SM2 私钥签名，返回十六进制签名</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Sm2Sign(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> plainText, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> privateKeyHex)
        </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm2.Sign(privateKeyHex, plainText, Encoding.UTF8);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">SM2 公钥验签</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> Sm2Verify(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> plainText, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> signatureHex, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> publicKeyHex)
        </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm2.VerifySign(publicKeyHex, plainText, signatureHex, Encoding.UTF8);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">C1C2C3 转 C1C3C2（对接 Java/前端时可能需要）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] Sm2C123ToC132(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] c1c2c3)
        </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm2.C123ToC132(c1c2c3);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">C1C3C2 转 C1C2C3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] Sm2C132ToC123(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] c1c3c2)
        </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm2.C132ToC123(c1c3c2);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endregion</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#region</span> SM3

    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">SM3 哈希，返回十六进制</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Sm3Hash(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> plainText)
        </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm3.GetHash(plainText, Encoding.UTF8);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">SM3 哈希（字节数组）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] Sm3Hash(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] plainBytes)
        </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm3.GetHash(plainBytes);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endregion</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#region</span> SM4

    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">生成 SM4 密钥（16 字节，32 位十六进制）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GenerateSm4KeyHex()
        </span>=&gt; Hex.ToHexString(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)).ToLowerInvariant();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">生成 SM4 IV（16 字节，32 位十六进制）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GenerateSm4IvHex()
        </span>=&gt; Hex.ToHexString(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)).ToLowerInvariant();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">SM4 加密（CBC + PKCS7），返回十六进制密文</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Sm4Encrypt(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> plainText, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> keyHex, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? ivHex = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        ivHex </span>??=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GenerateSm4IvHex();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm4.Encrypt(
            plainText,
            keyHex,
            ivHex,
            Sm4EncryptionNames.ModeCBC,
            Sm4EncryptionNames.PKCS7Padding,
            Encoding.UTF8);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">SM4 解密（CBC + PKCS7）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Sm4Decrypt(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cipherTextHex, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> keyHex, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ivHex)
        </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm4.Decrypt(
            cipherTextHex,
            keyHex,
            ivHex,
            Sm4EncryptionNames.ModeCBC,
            Sm4EncryptionNames.PKCS7Padding,
            Encoding.UTF8);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endregion</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">SM2 密钥对</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sm2KeyPairResult
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> PublicKeyHex { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; init; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> PrivateKeyHex { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; init; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-2xl" data-streamdown="heading-2">使用示例</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> YourCompany.GmCrypto;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ============================================================
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> SM2：非对称加密（公钥加密 / 私钥解密）+ 数字签名 / 验签
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 适用：密钥交换、小数据加密、身份认证、防篡改
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ============================================================

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 生成一对 SM2 密钥（公钥给别人加密/验签，私钥自己保管）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> keys =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SmHelper.GenerateSm2KeyPair();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> keys.PublicKeyHex  → 公钥（可公开）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> keys.PrivateKeyHex → 私钥（务必保密）

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 用【公钥】加密明文（只有对应私钥能解开）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> cipher = SmHelper.Sm2Encrypt(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, keys.PublicKeyHex);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> cipher 是十六进制密文字符串

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 用【私钥】解密密文，还原明文</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> plain =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SmHelper.Sm2Decrypt(cipher, keys.PrivateKeyHex);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> plain 应等于 "hello"

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 用【私钥】对数据签名（证明“是我签的、没被改过”）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> sign = SmHelper.Sm2Sign(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, keys.PrivateKeyHex);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> sign 是十六进制签名字符串

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 用【公钥】验签（确认签名是否有效、数据是否被篡改）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> ok = SmHelper.Sm2Verify(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, sign, keys.PublicKeyHex);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ok == true 表示验签通过


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ============================================================
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> SM3：哈希（摘要），不可逆
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 适用：密码摘要、数据完整性校验、配合 SM2 签名前的预处理等
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ============================================================

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 对字符串做 SM3 哈希，得到固定长度的十六进制摘要</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> hash = SmHelper.Sm3Hash(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 同样输入永远得到同样输出；无法从 hash 反推原文


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ============================================================
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> SM4：对称加密（同一个密钥加解密）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 适用：大批量数据加密、本地存储加密、报文加密等
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模式：CBC + PKCS7（类库内默认配置）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ============================================================

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 生成 16 字节（128 位）密钥，32 位十六进制</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> key =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SmHelper.GenerateSm4KeyHex();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 生成 16 字节 IV（初始化向量），CBC 模式必须</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> iv =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SmHelper.GenerateSm4IvHex();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 用 key + iv 加密明文</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> sm4Cipher = SmHelper.Sm4Encrypt(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, key, iv);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 若 iv 传 null，会自动生成；解密时必须用【同一个 iv】

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 用【相同 key + iv】解密密文</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> sm4Plain =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SmHelper.Sm4Decrypt(sm4Cipher, key, iv);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> sm4Plain 应等于 "hello"


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ============================================================
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 典型组合场景（注释说明，按需选用）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ============================================================

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 场景 A：传输敏感小数据
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   → SM2 加密（对方公钥加密，己方私钥解密）

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 场景 B：接口防篡改
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   → 发送方 Sm2Sign，接收方 Sm2Verify

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 场景 C：存密码 / 做指纹
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   → Sm3Hash（不要明文存密码）

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 场景 D：加密较长内容或文件内容
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   → 用 SM4；SM2 只用来加密 SM4 的 key（混合加密，需自行封装）

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 场景 E：与 Java / 前端对接 SM2 密文格式不一致时
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   → 可能需要 C1C2C3 ↔ C1C3C2 转换：
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span>   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> var converted = SmHelper.Sm2C123ToC132(cipherBytes);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">对应关系		
原来	            国密替代	  用途
MD5	            SM3	      数据摘要、完整性校验、指纹
SHA-1 / SHA-256	SM3	      同上（国密场景优先 SM3）
AES / DES	    SM4	      对称加密
RSA	            SM2	      非对称加密、签名
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
